text:
Lina (Sales): Quick heads-up 1: Meridian Care wants a 2-week POC. Baseline ~200 qps, demo spikes to ~900 qps for 1-3min. Model: open-llama-70B 4-bit. Need two pricing/capacity options + security answers by EOD.
Omar (Solutions Eng): got it. Any latency SLO for the demo?
Lina (Sales): target p50 250ms, p95 < 1s if possible.
Sofia (Infra): forensic note: q70B@4bit ~12-18 rps per GPU at 256 tokens; at 900 qps we'd want ~6-8 GPUs reserved to be safe with caching and batching.
Omar (Solutions Eng): propose two options:
- Safe: 8 reserved GPUs, burst to 12, pre-warmed KV cache.
- Lean: 5 reserved GPUs, burst credits to 16, strict 5min burst window + fallback.
Renee (Security): they asked about SOC2, SAML SSO, customer KMS, 12mo logs, and weights-export clause. Hosted can meet SAML+KMS; HSM attestation is Private-only.
Ben (AE): Marta, quick monthly delta?
Marta (Finance): reserved A100 equiv ~$20k/GPU/mo. Example: Safe ~8*$20k=$160k/mo; Lean ~5*$20k=$100k/mo + burst hours variable ($5k-$25k). One-time Private setup $25k-$50k.
Lina (Sales): Omar can you paste an autoscale snippet we can send?
Omar (Solutions Eng): paste below:
```
autoscale_policy:
  reserved_gpus: 5
  burst_max_gpus: 16
  burst_window: 300s
  cooldown: 600s
  p50_target_ms: 220
  circuit_break_p95_ms: 1000
  fallback_models: ["q70B-4bit","q13B-8bit"]
  kv_cache: enabled
  batching: dynamic(max=48)
```
Sofia (Infra): add routing: prefer Private cluster if customer picks Private; otherwise hosted w/ customer KMS. Also auto-failover to smaller model if p95>1s for >30s.
Renee (Security): I'll fill questionnaire with SOC2 yes, SAML+SCIM yes (enterprise), customer-managed KMS yes, HSM attestation only for Private, log retention configurable to 12 months, data deletion SLA 30 days. Will draft weights-export prohibition clause for Legal.
Ben (AE): I'll send two-option one-pager + security answers after we get a quick perf sweep.
ops-bot: Load test #zt-2237 queued by Omar. ETA ~4h. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Omar (Solutions Eng): running tests for 4/6/8/12 GPUs; will post p50/p95 and recommended option.
Lina (Sales): thanks team 1 - we'll align post-results and send to Meridian.
